description: This file contains the implementation of the CustomerOptionValueService, including methods for listing, saving/updating, deleting, and retrieving customer option values within a store context. It interacts with data access objects and other service layers for comprehensive customer attribute management.

classes.name: CustomerOptionValueServiceImpl
classes.description: Service implementation for managing customer option values, including CRUD operations, deletion handling, and retrieval by code, extending generic entity service and implementing CustomerOptionValueService.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Retrieves a list of CustomerOptionValue objects associated with a specific store and language.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves a new CustomerOptionValue or updates an existing one based on whether the ID is present.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a CustomerOptionValue and associated CustomerAttribute and CustomerOptionSet objects.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a CustomerOptionValue by its code within a specific store.
